final_message:
I added all three views to `notebooks/explore.py`. Each has a hypothesis cell before it and a facts cell after it. `marimo check` passes, and the whole notebook runs end to end with no cell errors. No live marimo session was running, so I edited the file directly.

**1. `shipments_per_month`**: monthly shipment counts as bars, with the April–June bars coloured.
- There are 1,199 shipments from Jan 2023 to Dec 2024. Monthly counts range from 35 to 60.
- 2023 Q2: 54, 55, 50. The other 2023 months range from 41 to 60.
- 2024 Q2: 35, 41, 39. The other 2024 months range from 43 to 59.

**2. `q2_dip_by_port`**: for each port and year, how far Q2 shipments per month differ from the rest of the year's monthly rate.
- In 2024, three ports dropped hard: Fennick −79.7%, Ivelholm −77.8% and Brackwater −63.8%. The other seven ranged from −18.9% to +25.8%.
- In 2023, those same three ranged from −5.9% to +15.4%.
- Each port handles only about 4–7 shipments a month, so one shipment moves a port's rate a lot.

**3. `q2_dip_by_carrier_type`**: the same measure for each carrier type.
- Tanker: +21.1% in 2023, −44.3% in 2024.
- Container: +1.5% in 2023, −28.5% in 2024.
- Bulk: −1.5% in 2023, −6.1% in 2024.

Each view groups its bars by year. The data suggests the dip is much bigger in 2024 than in 2023, and pooling the two years would hide that.

The facts cells hold only the numbers and don't say whether each outcome was met. Tell me your verdict on each hypothesis and I'll add it to its facts cell in your words.

return (shipments,)


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    ## Hypothesis 1: shipments dip in the second quarter

    Shipment counts drop in April–June. **Outcome:** in each year, the monthly counts for April, May and June sit below the counts for the other months.
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def shipments_per_month(mo, pl, shipments):
    import altair as alt

    _monthly = (
        shipments
        .group_by(pl.col('ship_date').dt.truncate('1mo').alias('month'))
        .agg(pl.len().alias('shipments'))
        .with_columns(q2=pl.col('month').dt.quarter().eq(2))
        .sort('month')
        .collect()
    )
    shipments_per_month_chart = mo.ui.altair_chart(
        alt.Chart(_monthly)
        .mark_bar()
        .encode(
            x=alt.X('yearmonth(month):T', title='Month'),
            y=alt.Y('shipments:Q', title='Shipments'),
            color=alt.Color('q2:N', title='Q2'),
            tooltip=['yearmonth(month):T', 'shipments:Q'],
        )
        .properties(width='container', height=300)
    )
    shipments_per_month_chart
    return (alt,)


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    **Facts.** 1,199 shipments across 24 months (Jan 2023 – Dec 2024). Monthly counts range from 35 (Apr 2024) to 60 (Mar 2023).

    - 2023 Q2: 54, 55, 50. The other 2023 months range from 41 to 60.
    - 2024 Q2: 35, 41, 39. The other 2024 months range from 43 to 59.
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    ## Hypothesis 2: a few ports cause the Q2 dip

    **Outcome:** three or fewer ports show a Q2 monthly rate well below their rate in the rest of the year, and the other ports stay flat.

    Dip = (Q2 shipments per month ÷ rest-of-year shipments per month − 1), per port and year.
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def q2_dip_by_port(alt, mo, pl, shipments):
    _dip = (
        shipments
        .with_columns(
            q2=pl.col('ship_date').dt.quarter().eq(2),
            year=pl.col('ship_date').dt.year().cast(pl.String),
        )
        .group_by('port', 'year')
        .agg(
            q2_per_month=pl.col('q2').sum().truediv(3),
            rest_per_month=pl.col('q2').not_().sum().truediv(9),
        )
        .with_columns(
            dip_pct=pl.col('q2_per_month').truediv(pl.col('rest_per_month')).sub(1).mul(100).round(1)
        )
        .collect()
    )
    q2_dip_by_port_chart = mo.ui.altair_chart(
        alt.Chart(_dip)
        .mark_bar()
        .encode(
            y=alt.Y('port:N', title='Port', sort=alt.EncodingSortField('dip_pct', op='min')),
            x=alt.X('dip_pct:Q', title='Q2 vs rest of year (%)'),
            yOffset='year:N',
            color=alt.Color('year:N', title='Year'),
            tooltip=['port:N', 'year:N', 'q2_per_month:Q', 'rest_per_month:Q', 'dip_pct:Q'],
        )
        .properties(width='container', height=400)
    )
    q2_dip_by_port_chart
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    **Facts.** 10 ports. Q2 vs rest-of-year change, per port:

    | Port | 2023 | 2024 |
    |---|---|---|
    | Fennick | +15.4% | −79.7% |
    | Ivelholm | −5.9% | −77.8% |
    | Brackwater | +3.3% | −63.8% |
    | Emberly Quay | +14.7% | −18.9% |
    | Aldermouth | +33.9% | −4.5% |
    | Dovesend | −26.7% | −2.2% |
    | Hollowmere | −18.2% | 0.0% |
    | Cindervale | +30.8% | +15.9% |
    | Glassford | 0.0% | +16.1% |
    | Juniper Reach | −21.4% | +25.8% |

    In 2024 the other seven ports range from −18.9% to +25.8%. Ports handle about 4–7 shipments a month each, so a single shipment moves a port's rate a lot.
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    ## Hypothesis 3: the Q2 dip belongs to one carrier type

    **Outcome:** one carrier type shows a much larger Q2 drop than the other two. Same dip measure as above, per carrier type and year.
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def q2_dip_by_carrier_type(alt, mo, pl, shipments):
    _dip = (
        shipments
        .with_columns(
            q2=pl.col('ship_date').dt.quarter().eq(2),
            year=pl.col('ship_date').dt.year().cast(pl.String),
        )
        .group_by('carrier_type', 'year')
        .agg(
            q2_per_month=pl.col('q2').sum().truediv(3),
            rest_per_month=pl.col('q2').not_().sum().truediv(9),
        )
        .with_columns(
            dip_pct=pl.col('q2_per_month').truediv(pl.col('rest_per_month')).sub(1).mul(100).round(1)
        )
        .collect()
    )
    q2_dip_by_carrier_type_chart = mo.ui.altair_chart(
        alt.Chart(_dip)
        .mark_bar()
        .encode(
            y=alt.Y('carrier_type:N', title='Carrier type', sort=alt.EncodingSortField('dip_pct', op='min')),
            x=alt.X('dip_pct:Q', title='Q2 vs rest of year (%)'),
            yOffset='year:N',
            color=alt.Color('year:N', title='Year'),
            tooltip=['carrier_type:N', 'year:N', 'q2_per_month:Q', 'rest_per_month:Q', 'dip_pct:Q'],
        )
        .properties(width='container', height=200)
    )
    q2_dip_by_carrier_type_chart
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    **Facts.** 3 carrier types. Q2 vs rest-of-year change:

    | Carrier type | 2023 | 2024 | Shipments (2 yrs) |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | tanker | +21.1% | −44.3% | 163 |
    | container | +1.5% | −28.5% | 707 |
    | bulk | −1.5% | −6.1% | 329 |
    """)
    return
